reviews.text: I absolutely LOVE how my hair turned out!! 😍I am very particular about who I let color or highlight my hair, and Rosie did such an amazing job! reviews.author: Allison Weber
reviews.text: I recently had a five-night stay at the Comfort Inn. I was searching for a budget-friendly hotel, and I'm very satisfied with my experience. I am someone who reads a lot of reviews and was a bit anxious to get there, but I was pleasantly surprised. I'm not sure if all rooms have been recently renovated, but mine was, and it was clean and the bathroom was especially nice. The quilts are a little scratchy if that's something that matters to you, but I didn't care, and I actually found the beds quite comfortable! The staff was extremely pleasant to deal with. I didn't swim in the pool, but every time I walked past there were tons of kids/teens having a great time. My room had a fridge and microwave which was excellent. There is an iHop attached to the hotel, but I didn't go, so I can't comment on that. Overall, I'm very satisfied with my stay and though it's not luxurious, the Comfort Inn provided me with everything I needed for a comfortable stay in Niagra Falls.

reviews.author: Lis Wall
reviews.text:
My first experience at this store was extremely disappointing and deeply upsetting. I walked in simply to purchase a snack after my workout, only to be immediately told that backpacks had to be left at the front of the store. I have never encountered this kind of treatment at a convenience store before, and the experience left me feeling singled out and unwelcome.

Racial profiling, whether intentional or not, is harmful, unacceptable, and has no place in our communities. No one should have to feel scrutinized or treated with suspicion simply for walking into a store with a backpack.

Businesses have a responsibility to treat all customers with dignity, fairness, and respect, regardless of their racial or cultural background. Experiences like this can leave a lasting impact and undermine a person’s sense of belonging and safety.

I refuse to spend my hard-earned money at an establishment where I feel unwelcome and will not be recommending this store to others. Respect and equal treatment should be the bare minimum, not a privilege.

As I take a look at the table to see what coins it required she starts yelling from the bar "This is not a pool hall. You have to buy alcohol to play on that table". Well, first, its illegal to force alcohol as per SMARTserve policies, but I didnt want to make a fuss so I countered with "Doesnt have to be alcohol right? Ill get a diet coke" to which she hesitantly agreed. I turn back to my friend, grabbed a 10 dollar bill and wait at the bar for change. The bartender starts arguing with me about not ordering a drink so I clarify that I had already ordered the diet coke. She shrugs and goes to the fridge and pulls out a two liter bottle of diet cola (compliments) and pours a glass to bring to me. I noticed the odd looking bottle that she hid away so I asked to see the bottle (because I needed to make sure it was zero sugar due to diabetic condition). She huffs and puffs and tells me "IM NOT DOING THIS HONEY, LEAVE". I tell her that I needed to make sure it didn't have sugar, but also, why is she fraudulently selling me diet cola instead of diet coke?

Overall, dont trust these people. So many better places closeby. To the owner, from a business perspective, reconsider your "assets".

reviews.author: Christina Robson
reviews.text:
I walked into a bar that smelled lemony fresh and the bathroom was clean.
I am so happy.

Christina

reviews.author: Behzad Farzipour
reviews.text: This will be my must go to place every time I'm in town, the people (staff and customers) were all really friendly, and the food was beyond expectations, absolutely fresh and delicious, must must must visit

reviews.author: Grace Brazeau
reviews.text: I walk into the place with my sister and mom it's very dark and smells unusual. The floor is sticky, and the place is very warn down. We got completely catfished the place was not as we expected as it showed on the website. We sat down at the table, and we were given paper menus as if it were printed off a Google document, and there were only 2. We had to use our phone flashlight to read the menu because the place was so dark. There was a bunch of bugs flying around, and the kitchen looked like a disaster. As soon as the cooks finished preparing our food instead of cleaning up, they went on their phones. The server was really nice. The food wasn't the best except the fries were okay. My sister ordered pasta, and the noodles were slightly uncooked. The quesadilla was not that good. The food was prepared quickly, and then They provided the fork, not a knife.

reviews.author: Vengeance Blade
reviews.text:
Fantastic hobby store with exceptional customer service and incredibly knowledgeable owners! They offer a great selection of Warhammer 40K, The Horus Heresy, Age of Sigmar, Magic: The Gathering, Pokémon, and LEGO, including loose LEGO pieces sold by the cup.

What really sets this store apart is the welcoming atmosphere and consistent hobby nights tailored to different game systems. Whether you're a seasoned hobbyist or just getting started, the owners are always happy to help, share their knowledge, and make you feel welcome.

More than just a hobby store, it's a great community hub. Highly recommend supporting this fantastic local business!

reviews.author: Carlos Alberto
reviews.text: Great little hobby shop! The staff is always friendly and helpful, and they have a nice selection of miniatures, paints, and hobby supplies. I always enjoy stopping by and checking out what they have. Definitely a place I’ll keep coming back to. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Orbona
reviews.text: Great staff, very friendly and welcoming. The environment is awesome, especially for the MTG nights.

reviews.author: Alex Grncarovski
reviews.text: Great store, super clean, great selection of Lego and Warhammer products. You can tell they take pride in their store. Staff are super friendly. They have snacks and drinks as well. Super welcome space for tabletop gamers in the falls.

reviews.author: Mitch Erickson
reviews.text: Grabbed some Legions Imperialis tanks here which is great because they're so hard to find in store. Great staff, the family that runs it really know their hobby stuff. They had Lego, MTG, Warhammer, table space for hobbying, seems like a great place to go.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Walsh
reviews.text: I ordered the son of a baconator combo, when I bit into it there was a piece of white hair inside my burger. I wasn’t mad or anything, accidents happen! But when I took the bun off there were several pieces of white hair/fluff(?). I went back in and they made me a new one, the staff were kind enough about it. The second burger was so thin the patties were see through and it still had hair in it. Poutine and strawberry lemonade were fine and normal but I ended up wasting the main part of a meal that cost $18.75

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.text: me and my girlfriend went here and this wonderful worker named Keisha gave us great customer service! she talked us through the menu and gave us a cheaper option of what we were supposed to get! the food was well done, saved a lot of money, and her overall mood is great! I’d definitely come here again just because of her.

reviews.author: Vanessa
reviews.text: Very good service! Came today around mid day and the lady at the cash was very nice. She explained the menu with knowledge and was very friendly. The restaurant was clean, washrooms were clean and the atmosphere was great. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Kaylie Lynn
reviews.text: Customer service did not speak English. They did not get the order right, I had to come back and they gave me another order which had way too much seasoning. Customer service was disrespectful, and did not speak English. not food to serve to people, not a great overall service.

reviews.author: Jodhveer Saini
reviews.text: Hello Am Jodhveer. I visited the Wendy’s on Lundy’s Lane a couple of days ago for dine-in and ordered a Dave’s Single Combo and kids meal. The food was fresh and tasted great. What made my visit even better was the excellent customer service from Harpreet, who was working at the front cashier. She was friendly, polite, and made the ordering process quick and easy. It’s always nice to be treated with kindness. I really enjoyed my experience and will definitely be back. Great job, Harpreet!

reviews.author: olivia cahill
reviews.text: I wish I could give this hotel zero stars. My father, brother, and I attempted to stay in this hotel over a weekend. Upon our entry, we walked into lights that did not work. The smoke detector was going off every 2-5 minutes. There were large stains on the sheets. This was all noticeable within 3 minutes of entering. Unbelievably, worse issues were still to come. We found a BUG in the bed. We were informed by several other guests of bugs in their rooms as well. When we went to talk to the front desk about a cancellation and refund. We were met with the worst customer service I have ever experienced. We had staff members laugh and essentially accuse us of lying. They refused to refund the stay unless an inspector verified the presence of bugs in our room. We were told we should have simply moved to a different room instead of finding a new hotel. Later, the room inspection came back positive for bugs; lucky, we received a full refund. This was the worst hotel experience of my and my family's lives. DO NOT stay at this hotel unless you want to return home emotionally (and possibly physically) scarred and bug-infested.

reviews.author: Sherri MacLean
reviews.text:
We stayed for over a week. Never seen any sort of bug not even an ant. The bedding could have been better there was burn marks on the comforter. Our 1st room the bed broke but they moved us right away to the next room.
Not 1 person complained about my 3 yr old twin grandsons. So that was nice
Staff was amazing. Can not say enough about how wonderful they were. Even when I brought the boys downstairs they were so great.
Breakfast was good just basic stuff. But it was okay. The kitchen is now open with the restaurant so that's  good ad the have 2 meals from 29$.
Pool was great. Bathrooms were clean.
I was really worried to stay there as I had read and heard about all these crazy things. But it wasn't like that. We had an outside room no carpet. Which was great. They allow dogs but there is a daily charge as fr parking also a daily charge.
But it is a decent  place and staff are the best!!!!!!

reviews.author: Connor Kropf
reviews.text:
I wouldn’t stay here again. Room itself is clean and decent. Worst check in ever. Was told repeatedly there was a $100 security deposit upon check in which was no issue, but not one person mentioned that was only by credit card and it would be $300 if paying by debit. If we hadn’t already paid for our room we wouldn’t have stayed here. That put a damper on our holiday. Front desk staff were extremely unhelpful, were not up front about everything needed to secure check in.  Bathroom has needed an update since the 90s.

Bedside lamp doesn’t work, light switch beside bed turns bathroom light on on other side of room.

We were also told repeatedly that we would get the security deposit back when we checked out. Upon checkout we were told that we get it back in 2-5 days. The staff is inconsistent and out to make a buck it seems.

reviews.author: Matthew Graham
reviews.text: Could be a motel in a scary movie.  Water dripped on my head from the leak in the ceiling during check in.. The room we were given was so dirty our feet were black from the floors with in minutes. Bathroom was disgusting blood splattered on walls, bath tub had burn marks and tolit was stained yellow. The bed was uncomfortable one pillow per side and we asked for more we were told there wasn't any pillows available. Our TV was static no phone in room. If you want a fridge or microwave you have to pay extra. On our 3rd day during breakfast the ceiling fell in due to the rain overnight. The continental breakfast was very upsetting stale bread, watered-down coffee, no fruit, no cereal, store bought muffins and yogurt cups was all there was. The management is horrible no customer service, don't care about customer satisfaction, very rude and if I owned this business I would be very embarrassed. Overall the worst hotel I've ever been to. Avoid at all costs is my advice

reviews.author: Nataschia Crew
reviews.text: Its a place to stay budget friendly, staff is also very nice, some rooms are in the process of being updated. Our heater was making a noise, and toilet was flushing for no reason. But the hotel offered to change my room. The noise and flush didn't bother us, and it was a snow storm. So most staff for cleaning all called off sick. But the front desk and manager ....they over worked themselves to please customers. Plus I got a free late check out until 1:pm. Which was perfect for me. As I needed rest. The jacuzzi queen room which I got was enormous. Plenty leg room in the jacuzzi and its oversized for 2. So your comfortable. The hotel is an older look, but the beds are modern. The breakfast is continental, only boiled eggs for a hot choice. But you can enjoy, bagels, yogurt, muffins, coffee, tea, juice, toast and a few other stuff which is perfect during a winter storm. Especially if your not about driving in the snow. Truthfully the hotel needs some upgrades like their curtains and furniture but the staff is so nice and friendly that you see past that. More over this hotel is animal friendly. Saw a few cute pups during my stay.

reviews.author: Bella k Ashley
reviews.text: WATCH OUT THEY MAKE YOU PAY FOR TIP WHEN YOU NEVER PUT TIPS! This place I highly do not recommend. I went to go buy a sub for someone and I asked for it to be to go and on the Receipt it said to dine in I never said dine in and she still put it on the receipt.  Then on the receipt it said i gave a $2.20 tip like when did I say I wanted to give a tip? THE PEOPLE WHO ATTENDED ME WERE A OLD WOMAN AND A TALL MAN. I DEFINITELY WILL NEVER BE COMING BACK HERE.

reviews.author: Sijo Chacko

My wife asked him why he was impatient by saying 'oh my God' then his coworker was defending him by saying that he said to him and not to the customer. He treated us as if we went in to dine in free. Please find workers who care for customers. Never in this location again😩

reviews.text: Dont buy from this place, there food smells so bad, i couldnt eat the food. Isnt a clean place or sanatized. The food smells gross

reviews.author: Parevi Patel
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointed with the service at this Subway location. I placed a large order of 8 footlongs and spent over $75, and the experience was absolutely not worth it.

The staff — particularly an older lady and a tall male employee — were incredibly rude and unprofessional. I specifically ordered multigrain bread, but they gave me a different bread without saying anything. When I politely asked for extra sauce and vegetables, the older lady responded rudely and didn’t even add them to the subs. I even said “thank you” at the end of my order, and neither of them had the decency to respond or acknowledge me.

There was no greeting, no customer service, and no sense of customer priority. The entire experience felt toxic and careless, and honestly, like I was being a burden instead of a paying customer.

I regret spending my money here — think twice before visiting this location.

reviews.author: Meet Patel
reviews.text:

The staff was friendly and welcoming, and the service was quick even during a busy evening. I ordered the  Margherita, and it was hands down one of the best I’ve had in Niagara Falls. Highly recommended for anyone craving quality pizza!

Root is very gentleman and most humble person. I really appreciate the service quality and taste of pizza. Must visit to fulfill all your pizza cravings.

reviews.text: Typical ma' and pa' pizza place in a plaza.  Came in late night for a slice, didn't expect much as it was late and the slices were most likely sitting for a while, but reheated.. the meat lovers pizza slices where very good.. good dough, good toppings and it reheated very nicely.  Good place.

reviews.text: Best pizza in the town!!!They can make customized pizza as per request. One of the most delicious pizzas that I have ever had in Canada. Best for vegetarian options too.

reviews.author: Pushpa Modhavadiya
reviews.text:
I had a really great experience at this dental clinic! I got my teeth cleaned, cavities filled, and a root canal retreated, and I’m genuinely happy with the care I received.

The entire experience with Dr. Alan was so comfortable and reassuring. He was so kind, patient, and professional, and he made me feel comfortable throughout the treatments. I really appreciate the way he took care of everything and made what can sometimes be a stressful dental experience feel much easier.

Finding a dental clinic where you feel comfortable, cared for, and confident in the treatment is so important, and I’m glad I found one. Thank you so much Dr. Alan Sian and the entire team for your kindness, patience, and excellent care. I truly appreciate all your efforts.

reviews.author: Cecil Lynes
reviews.text: I had a great experience at this dental office! The staff were friendly, professional, and understanding. They took the time to explain my treatment options and were considerate of my financial situation. I really appreciated their honesty, affordability, and willingness to help me find the best option for my dental needs without feeling pressured. It’s not always easy finding quality dental care at a reasonable price, so I’m grateful for the experience. I would definitely recommend this office to anyone looking for affordable, compassionate dental care!

reviews.author: Gurdeep Mahey
reviews.text: I’m incredibly grateful to this dental clinic for their kindness, compassion, and support when I was in severe pain. ALAN ♥️✨AND HIS STAFF  who genuinely care about their patients and go above and beyond to help. Thank you for your kindness and for making such a stressful experience so much better. Highly recommend this wonderful clinic! Seriously Amazing People team 🥹💗

reviews.author: komal
reviews.text: Huge thanks to Dr. ALAN  for his incredible kindness and generosity! My tooth filling was ruined by another clinic, but Dr. Alan went above and beyond and even gifted me the filling. 🥹❤️ His care and compassion truly touched my heart. As well as the staff is really kind ♥️Highly recommend this amazing clinic to anyone looking for excellent dental care! Forever grateful! 💗✨

reviews.author: Aimen khan
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Dr.Alan and his team. The service was excellent, professional and very friendly. He explained the process of my dental work perfectly and paced it to not overwhelm me all at once.  His staff is very accommodating and booked my appointment to perfectly fit with my work schedule.
I will be returning!

reviews.author: marcella gallart
reviews.text: Without a doubt, the best dental clinic in Niagara. I was warmly welcomed from the moment I walked in. The entire staff is amazing! Maria, the hygienist who did my cleaning, was so attentive and kind, and the receptionists, Nicky and Vanessa, are a 10/10—just wonderful. The owner, Dr. Nour, was incredible and explained everything in detail for me. I loved the whole team, and the assistants Thales and Gisele were fantastic as well. Definitely my favorite clinic in a long time! 🙏🏻❤️✨

reviews.author: Raghad Alyafi
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at my recent dental hygiene and examination appointment.  The dental examination by Dr. Nour was very thorough , and everything was explained clearly to me . The cleaning was great , they have amazing equipment that marks all the plaque for a thorough cleaning and it removed all the stains.

The entire team was friendly, welcoming, and attentive. The amenities they provide while on the chair are so comforting and relaxing. I truly appreciated the excellent care and would highly recommend this dental office to anyone looking for professional and compassionate dental care

reviews.author: Tanya Thomas
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Kalar Dental. Dr. Nour is incredibly knowledgeable, gentle, and takes the time to explain everything clearly, which made me feel very comfortable and well cared for throughout my visit.

The staff are just as amazing—friendly, welcoming, and highly professional. From the moment I walked in, the entire team made the experience smooth and stress-free. The clinic is clean, well-organized, and runs on time, which I really appreciated.

I highly recommend Kalar Dental, Dr. Nour, and the entire team to anyone looking for high-quality dental care!

reviews.author: Man Man
reviews.text:
​Absolutely love this office! Beyond being a beautiful standalone location with cozy vibes, the atmosphere here is so genuinely welcoming. Every single staff member has a smile on their face, and you can constantly hear lighthearted laughter throughout the office! Knowing that everyone here truly loves what they do instantly put me at ease and made me feel like I was in great hands.

​What really sets them apart is how thoroughly they explain every step of your care. Instead of expecting blind trust, they take intraoral photos and visually walk you through why they recommend a treatment. I first came in as a new patient in April for X-rays and a gum health assessment. Dr. Nour prioritized what was most important without ever being pushy, and my hygienist was fantastic- she educated me well and motivated me to take control of my oral health.

​Dr. Nour later did a restoration for me (im deathly afraid of needles...this was the most comfortable needle experience ever), and she is a true artist- it looks so natural you can’t even tell work was done! I’ve also done whitening here with amazing results and recently returned for a cleaning.

Between their top-tier technology and patient comforts like cozy blankets and noise-canceling headphones, every visit is a great experience. In just five months, my oral health has improved tenfold and my gums don't bleed after following the hygienist's advice. I can't recommend them enough! I am addicted to wanting to care for my teeth 🫰🏼

Lovely team of 🦷🧚‍♀️🧚‍♂️ here!

reviews.author: Lydia R
reviews.text: Both dentists there are super amazing! Very kind, and caring, they take the time to explain what they are doing, and make sure you are okay throughout! Great place to go to if your someone with a-lot of dental anxiety, they are understanding and very  patient if you need to take a break. Fully non-judgemental and are just oriented in wanting to help you restore your oral health and smile! The hygienists/ dental assistants and receptionists are also super nice and friendly. Overall 10/10 recommend to anyone, looking for a quality dental clinic :)

reviews.author: Joe Talarico
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience at Amore Eyewear ! From the moment I walked in, the customer service was top-notch. The staff took the time to really listen to what I wanted and needed, instead of just pointing me toward the nearest pair of glasses and wishing me luck.

Their attention to detail was impressive — they helped me find frames that suited my style, comfort, and budget, all while making the process easy and enjoyable. I never felt rushed or pressured, just genuinely cared for.

Shopping for glasses can sometimes feel like speed dating with your own face, but the team made it fun and stress-free. Thanks to their patience and expertise, I walked out feeling confident and seeing clearly — in more ways than one!

Highly recommend for anyone looking for great service, knowledgeable staff, and a truly personalized experience.

reviews.author: Rich Merlino
reviews.text: Great service! I purchased my 3rd pair of Persol glasses and have never been disappointed. I sheepishly asked for a rush on the glasses just before Christmas leading up to my 60th birthday as these were a gift to myself. After being told it would take a minimum of 6 weeks I surprisingly received them within 10 days. Thank you ladies for always providing exceptional customer service!

reviews.author: Your Roof Specialist
reviews.text: The best service. Quality products and lenses. My wife and I always get our glasses from them. A+ All around if you’re looking for quality

reviews.author: Loudgy Eshak
reviews.text: Amazing services everyone in the staff is super kind and will go above and beyond for you! Definitely coming back here again!

reviews.author: Craig Brennan
reviews.text: After 15 years of being a customer, I can confidently say that Amore Eyewear is simply the best. The service is consistently excellent, and the staff is always quick, punctual, and helpful. I wouldn't trust anyone else with my glasses!

reviews.author: Jamie Leitch
reviews.text: Two important things about a paint store are good quality paint and good staff. This store scores high on both of those. Staff are always very helpful. As soon as I walk in the door they greet me and ask how they can help. They are knowledgeable and friendly. I brought in 2 colour samples from other stores: a paint chip and a can of paint with the colour codes on the lid. They matched both, as far as I can tell perfectly. They've got all the tools and accessories you would need for your home painting project. And Dulux paint is superior to the big box store brands as far as I've found. I would recommend this store.

reviews.author: MustangCruise WineTours
reviews.text: Received some paint today and even though I was running a couple of min past 6pm Anika stayed to ensure I received the paint needed.  ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Victor Mansilla
reviews.text: Excellent products, like working with the weather guard for exterior.

reviews.author: kidk3245
reviews.text:
I recently needed paint to retouch my house and started by buying a bucket from Home Depot for $30. Although they couldn’t perfectly match my original paint, they made a genuine effort, which I appreciated. I decided to try the original supplier for a closer match and went to this location twice.

The first time, I asked if they could match the paint, and even a small sample would have helped me decide if I wanted to purchase it. However, the staff was hesitant to even try and informed me that the formula was discontinued. I left the store disappointed.

After thinking it over, I decided to return and asked if they could at least get the paint close to the original so I could paint a different wall. I was forced to consider this because they had discontinued the formula. To my surprise, when I asked about the cost, she said it would be $70 per bucket, while I had just bought a new bucket from Home Depot for $30.

Not only did I not get the matching paint, but I was also quoted more than double the price. I’m extremely dissatisfied with their service and the discontinuation of the formula, which forced me to compensate in such an expensive and inconvenient way.

reviews.author: Kayla
reviews.text: Every time I call this location someone answers politely and is able to help me with all the questions I usually have. Yesterday I called and talked with Jessica and I am so happy with her customer service! She collected a bunch of the little paint cards - some I specifically asked for and some complimenting the colours I asked for. She put them nicely in an envelope so I could go by and collect them later on. I am super impressed with the level of customer service she provided and I can't wait to go back and grab the paint I'll end up ordering. Dulux also has the best paint!

reviews.author: A F
reviews.text: Great service. Great prices. Perfectly cooked breakfast. This is a cute family restaurant that is trying hard, and doing a good job. A good meal and not a torusit trap. They also have a cute gift shop and henna tattoos! Recommended.

reviews.author: Viivek Satghar
reviews.text: I’m not impressed with the food portion size for bread as well as food quality. . Not recommended for public health reasons.  Huge blunders found in the menu which needs to be rectified. Breads need to be well cooked . Restaurant Ambience is not appealing , looks like a part time convenience store and then a restaurant. Unnecessary materials like vacuum cleaners should be eliminated from the restaurant dining areas . Please work on the food quality as well as service for a better future even if the restaurant is running for a long time . Thank you very much . I hope this feedback helps you to understand , learn and take positive out of it .

reviews.author: Riya Verma
reviews.text: The food was totally disgusting, we ordered butter chicken, garlic naan and coke for pickup but we got oil with some outdated sauces and half cooked chicken, got 12 naan instead of 16 and coke was missing

reviews.author: tanish kaushik
reviews.text:
They have the best chinese food in niagara falls.
I am from New delhi, and i love street food. I can say they can give you the taste from delhi streets.

reviews.author: Dario Rubio
reviews.text:
We had breakfast at this restaurant the 2 days we stayed at Niagara. Both the western style ( eggs, bacon and toast ) as well as the Indian one ( a traditional Indian style wrap of potatoes with chutney and yogurt ) were absolutely delicious.

Moreover the atmosphere that the owner/ cook has makes you feel like she's preparing it for a family member so 5 starts aren't enough to show our gratitude for a.n excellent service.

Two absolute thumbs up to this restaurant.

reviews.author: Claire Bouchard
reviews.text: I was very happy with my order. Mai Thai platter, coconut peanut and panang curry with shrip, and chicken and shrimp curry pad Thai. I was craving Thai food and google said this was nearest me. Wasn't expecting much but turned out to be a great find. That peanut curry was so good. I would order it again. Big servings for the price and the staff was really friendly. Definitely satiated my Thai food craving. Will definitely go back to try more.

reviews.author: Geraldine
reviews.text:
I really enjoy the food at this Thai restaurant — the flavors are bold, fresh, and satisfying. The dishes I’ve tried, like the pad Thai and green curry, have been delicious and full of authentic taste.

That said, the experience can be a bit inconsistent, likely depending on who’s in the kitchen. Some visits have been spot-on, while others were just okay — not bad, but noticeably different in flavor or spice level.

Still, the quality overall is good, the staff is friendly, and I keep coming back because when it’s on point, it’s really great. Worth a try if you’re in the mood for Thai!

reviews.author: Ashley Vuong
reviews.text: Very calm and chill place :) the food was pretty good but not the best, had a bit of trouble ordering because we didn’t know what to get but it was overall super delicious. The waiter that served us was Vietnamese too like us so that was very nice. The music here is calm and relaxing. Not a lot of people very good :D.

reviews.author: Jerandy Beato
reviews.text: Definitely authentic Thai cuisine! My boyfriend and I came here to eat during the lunch special and the food was delicious and flavorful! Lots of vegan, vegetarian options as well! We got the basil rice with chicken and the peanut curry with chicken and for dessert we got the mango sticky rice. 10/10!! The service was friendly and quick. The restaurant is really clean and such a calm atmosphere. I recommend this restaurant to anyone who is in the area. Great for lunch and affordable! Kid friendly as well ☺️ they also have a gluten free menu

reviews.author: Nadiia Mykhailiuk
reviews.text: This little Thai restaurant is absolutely gorgeous. It was our first time here and we didn’t know what to choose from the menu. The lovely lady who served our table was so kind and friendly. She is also owner of this restaurant. She helped us to choose the dishes and everything were freshly made and super delicious. You must try beef basil stirfry  - yummy!!! and chicken cashew is tasty as well. Service was fantastic. We felt like we came to our best friends. They offer lunch special menu as well as regular menu. Also they have Date Night for couple and you pay only $50 for two people for dinner. It’s a great deal! I highly recommend this incredible restaurant. We can’t wait to come back again and try more delicious, fresh, well-priced Thai food.

reviews.author: Jy Cruize
reviews.text: Had my recent order late night hours for 40 percent off , order was made and was not satisfied. The feedback from the manager was responsive to stay true to its quality and customer satisfaction. They reach out and made sure customers are satisfied and provided a  pizza without me having to pay for my next visit . True to their words they did provide the pizza free with great service and topping made to perfection. Thank you .

reviews.author: jimy joe
reviews.text: The app was a little confusing but very accurate. Perfect timing for pick up and food being packaged. Great taste and price. Very happy this location.

reviews.author: Ebonie Murrell
reviews.text:
Disgusting , unprofessional and inappropriate .. Is are only ways to describe What I witnessed today . My daughter and I had stopped in store to pick up an order we placed via the app . 2 items for 4.99 . What a great deal . Admittedly. .i have got it a few times over the last bit  and always treated with such kindness while in store .
Today was a different story , As I entered the establishment, I could immediately tell that the vibe  was different . The staff who once smiled Kept their heads down in order to avoid or possibly ignore the Inexcusable way the manager spoke to the staff . I wasn’t in the store too long But watched him Publicly berate his staff in a store full of customers . I exchanged glances with a woman who seemed  as Uncomfortable as me . I then asked the front desk off if that was a manager and she confirmed,  As he continued to berate his staff.. Before I left, I decided I was gonna say something And called the manager over to advise him that I felt it was unprofessional the way he was speaking to his staff .. He walked away from me . Commenting for me to have a nice day while his back is turned .  All the stuff that are lovely, but unfortunately, with this being a locally owned establishment . I cannot continue to support.

reviews.author: Paulette Gaudette
reviews.text: Requested well done pizza which I order frequently but tonight it was sorely undercooked and I had to throw it out

reviews.author: Jersey girl 62
reviews.text: Real bacon on her half! Mine is full of pineapple and hot peppers just like I asked for!! We used to order from another "family" pizza place.. not anymore !! Dominos is the best for quality and cost. The delivery guy was friendly and polite as well, seriously this is the best pizza we've had in a long time. Thankyou.

reviews.author: Chloe Ocampo
reviews.text: Sam is incredibly helpful and knowledgeable. She always makes the experience enjoyable and seamless. She is a very genuine person and goes above and beyond to assist customers. I would definitely recommend this PetValu location.

reviews.author: Tim Kim
reviews.text:
We came here last month for our dachshund's food. Old lady working at night gave us great suggestions after listening to our pet's situation. Price is not so cheap but overall it is nice and easy to explore for stuff that you need. They also started selling Orijen and Acana dog food which are Canadian made and many people have recommended us. Although I do not think this will be our main mostly because of the price, but I think we could give them some good food after another.

Has large parking lot which is free, great customer service with membership system to save some money, clean and organized environment, has a shower place for dogs where we can try different products and clean our pet with less backpain. Sometimes they have activities for pets in the store. Definetly coming back especially when there are special deals.

reviews.author: JP
reviews.text: Spacious and well organized store. Gabby and Skippy loved the  bath (so did I because it was much easier, and less messy than bathing them at home). Staff was very friendly and super knowledgeable about products. Highly recommend, and will return!

reviews.author: Cristina V
reviews.text: We visited tonight with our new Westie puppy and the associate working was very attentive, friendly, knowledgeable and helpful. We forget her name but thank you so much.

reviews.author: Rosemary D
reviews.text: This store is well stocked with a variety of good quality items for your pet and I have made many purchases here.  Staff greets you with smiles and are anxious to help you out immediately with whatever you need.  If you walk in with your pet, a staff member will always make sure they get a treat.  However, there is one person that works here that doesn't seem to fit in with the rest of the people working at this store.  Heather never greets you with a smile and always looks as if she doesn't want to be there.  When you ask her for help it is not done with a smile nor courtesy, and even when you have purchased something she still has that scowl on her face.  I've never heard her once say, "Bye!  Have a nice day", nor "Hello!  How are you today?"  When she's around I don't like being in the store because she makes me (you) feel like she doesn't want you there!  She's also the only one that has never given my dog a treat, not even when a purchase is made.  She definitely does not fit in with all the others.  This is the only complaint I have; otherwise, this is really an excellent store to shop for your pet(s).

reviews.author: Sana Talmeez
reviews.text:
Overall a good dine in place. Tried it for the first time last weekend and it was a decent spot for dine in. The ambience was calm, and looked clean. The food was lacking flavors but looked fresh. It was economical and the portion size was good.
The lady at the front desk (not sure if she's the owner) seemed a bit stern/not so welcoming. The other staff was good and quick at service.

reviews.author: Mani M
reviews.text:
I had dinner and ordered fried rice, lemon chicken, chilli chicken, and chicken wings. The flavors or taste were (VERY) less compared to the food prepared in other Chinese restaurants.

All the chicken dishes were battered by default, lacking in seasoning, sauce, and tastiness.

Honestly, I didn't expect Chinese cuisine to taste like this and will not recommend if you are looking for an authentic / delicious chinese crusine.

reviews.author: maricel morton
reviews.text: Last April our experienced is not good server was busy cleaning on other tables barely check on us that what my birthday dinner but two days ago everything  went perfect  we went for lunch a group of 10 so far this time magnolia  didn't disappoint  me food are good service was good our server  always checked on us asked what  we need thumps up to our server our lunch date was good

reviews.author: Mark Zaragoza
reviews.text:
Magnolia Fried Rice with Chicken is one of the best chicken fried rice’s I’ve ever had. You can really taste the wok infused flavours!  Orange chicken was flavorful, veggies were a great compliment. Calamari had good seasoning but was a little chewy.

Portions for were great for all dishes and the food came out quick. The staff were all very kind and provided service with a smile.

First but definitely not the last time coming here!

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.text: We had a wonderful dining experience! The food was flavorful, tasty, and served in generous portions. Prices were very fair for the quality and quantity offered. The restaurant itself was clean and welcoming, but what really stood out was the friendly and genuine staff who made us feel right at home. A big plus for our family was that they happily served French fries for the kids, which made the little ones just as happy as we were. Overall, excellent customer service and a truly enjoyable visit.  We will definitely be coming back! Let's not forget free parking and lots of space to move around. Again if you want an awesome customer service and most tasty food try this restaurant you will not regret it.

reviews.author: Anjaley
reviews.text:
I ordered an original iced matcha, and it was honestly ridiculous. It had barely any cane sugar in it and didn’t have even the slightest hint of sweetness. It tasted completely different from the exact same drink I’ve ordered at other branches.

What’s even more frustrating is that the staff here constantly seem to rush through orders and take shortcuts, which repeatedly results in incomplete or incorrect orders. It’s extremely disappointing to pay for something and not even receive it properly. This location seriously needs to do better.

reviews.author: Agnes Hawkins
reviews.text: Isn't very clean looks like it hasn't been swept or mopped in a while. Garbage all over the floors. Tables haven't been wiped down. Prep area is the same. Management isn't very good at this location if this is acceptable to them.

reviews.author: Steve Lilliman
reviews.text: I go here alot simply because it's where most of my acquaintances go. Unfortunately on one occasion I entered the establishment and plugged in my phone and a battery bank to charge and went outside for a cigarette and converse with an acquaintance before purchasing anything and the manager of the place took it upon himself to take my things and put them in his office. I was absolutely beside myself and the gentleman who was sitting right there said nothing. This manager is very lucky I didn't have himself and the establishment sued. Keep it in mind folks. Oh.....and the service is terrible, unfortunately.

reviews.author: Marc D'Amelio
reviews.text: I came in last night to get myself a french vanilla to reheat in the morning, I had walked there but arrived with around 12 minutes to spare which is more than enough time for me to get my french vanilla. The women there were visibly and audibly annoyed as I walked in. After receiving my french vanilla I walked over to a table to set it down for a second so I could properly put my wallet away before continuing my walk (mind you, with again 10 minutes left to spare until closing at 10pm) and the two women working started yelling as if they were super worried that I would sit down and ruin their plan to close early. Needless to say I left quickly after that, as I was walking out the girls were holding the door open almost rushing me out. Right after I was out the door they closed 10 minutes early ignoring the other people who were outside and possibly ready to order. I dont appreciate being yelled at like that, I was setting a drink down. Also I understand the decency of not ordering a huge meal before closing but I ordered a french vanilla they get out of a machine.. again...with 10 minutes to spare. The closing ladies were very rude and audibly and visibly annoyed. Do not recommend.

reviews.author: Brendan P
reviews.text: It took too long but it was a busy Tims on a morning, the best part is just hanging out meeting new people around here during coffee runs, being close to some resorts. I love it despite not usually eating here anymore. Did enjoy my black coffee before the drive back. Was tasty this time, could be the location too, which I am not usually used to in a GTA Tims. This Niagara location is nice and easy to access.

reviews.author: Shasteen Najjar Clarke
reviews.text:
This place needs to offer wheel barrow service to your vehicle…. Please alert the owners. Julie was my customer service representative and server she was patient with me as I’ve never been to this establishment and my child who had just had recent oral surgery this morning and had limitations to what they can actually eat and chew… I can’t express the cleanliness and tidiness and ambience of this place. My friends and colleagues at work have always recommended, and TODAY,  has been my first experience upon walking in ….
everything was incredible from the customer greeting to the seating to making me comfortable being patient for explaining the menu. … I’m a very particular individual and I really do not like when somebody doesn’t have patience to explain to me some of my options …. especially when this is the first time that I’ve visited.
That was not the situation here for me today or the experience that my child and I had to encounter.
I have to say I even stopped to ask a question about wings to Miss Jenna, who was incredibly excited to tell me about her favorite options and I was able to make my decision…. YES I ordered wings. I ordered pizza and my child ordered pasta. I will be back. I’m very happy and not to mention,…. Everyone knows the new menu which has been launched two weeks ago and we’re able to assist with professional professionalism and caring.
My photos below were very limited because only I was so focused on eating cause everything tasted so good came out hot and fresh. The black bowl with the cream sauce was actually the chicken Alfredo. I’m sorry I will post again when I have a better picture. It would have been a great photo… 💕💕💕💕

reviews.author: PF FP
reviews.text: We recently had dinner here with my son’s hockey team. A large, private section of the restaurant was reserved for the team. The service provided by Cooper and his wife was incredible. Taking orders for about 50 people is not easy and everything came out exactly as ordered and very quickly! The food and drinks were great. Highly recommend this place!!

reviews.author: CHV
reviews.text: Six of us enjoyed an outstanding lunch here. Server Ava F was great- friendly, attentive and personable. Most of us ordered off the very reasonably priced lunch menu. Those of us who ordered the Buffalo chicken wrap asked to have it made with honey garlic instead of Buffalo sauce - it was AH-MAZING! The crunchy chicken tenders used in these generously stuffed wraps were delicious. The upgraded sweet potato fries stolen off a mate’s plate were the best I’ve had. My side harvest salad was great; loved the roasted chickpeas. Definitely recommend checking this place out when you’re in the area. Everyone in our party agreed - and in the words of Arnold Schwarzenegger: “I’ll be back”!

reviews.author: Sanjay Jeganathan
reviews.text: Great little unpretentious place. Very simple small menu. The food and service are excellent. The staff are very friendly and efficient. Was there 15 years ago, place and atmosphere have not changed. The menu has changed a little bit. Food is still excellent.

reviews.author: Brooklyn Daly
reviews.text: Amazing place with amazing staff! Everyone was attentive and kind! Jenna went above and beyond for us and fixed up something we needed ! The manager on staff tonight I forgot to ask for the name again but she had red hair and was fantastic! Can’t wait to come back:) such a great first experience

reviews.author: Iman Iman
reviews.text: I had breakfast here and absolutely loved the veggie omelet! The atmosphere was wonderful, the food was excellent, and the staff were incredibly friendly, kind, and supportive. Especially Vesna. Overall, it was a great experience, and I would definitely recommend this place for breakfast or lunch!

reviews.author: Tobias Martinsen
reviews.text: The best type of breakfast spot. Extensive menu, calm atmosphere, reasonable prices and attentive service. They also accommodate very well for gluten free options - I recommend the Philly Benedict in particular!

reviews.author: Kaiden Kaine
reviews.text: Incredible food. Came out quick and fresh while still tasting amazing. The staff is incredible and polite. Highly recommend coming here.

reviews.author: Mark Kaine
reviews.text:
Best value in Niagara for a breakfast.
Always fresh always good.
Owned and operated by a wonderful couple who serve their customers like family.

reviews.author: Lili
reviews.text: A busy local restaurant, almost lunch time , still had to wait for about 20 minutes to be seated. The food overall is fresh and tasty.

reviews.author: S Z
reviews.text: Our granddaughters had demanded to eat Frozen yogurt from CC Swirls as they had lunch liked the place previously. It is very nice and clean place with self serving machines where one can choose different flavours in cups of different sizes and then may add some toppings and pay by the weight. Server is a nice lady and there is plenty of Parking 🅿️ there.

reviews.author: Faisal Shaikh
reviews.text:
Great experience!
Wonderful atmosphere, reasonable prices, and fantastic service! From the moment we walked in, the clean, welcoming environment set the perfect mood. The prices were very fair for the quality provided, making it an excellent value overall. I will definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great spot!

reviews.author: Rachel Looyestein
reviews.text: Visited today (August 12) and was really disappointed. The frozen yogurt was decent, but the service was absolutely terrible. The entire time we were in there, there was no other customers, so no excuse for such poor service. The older gentleman working was MISERABLE, and acted like we were an annoying inconvenience. He had no patience for the young children choosing their toppings. I knew it was be expensive, but usually the excitement of picking their own icecream makes it somewhat worth the price. However, they couldn’t do their own toppings, and were treated like an annoyance when trying to tell the gentleman what they would like. We will definitely not be returning to this location and will take our business elsewhere, somewhere where the staff at least pretend to like customers and children. I would also like to add that I never write reviews, I don’t think I’ve ever written a negative review in my 40 years of life, and my girls are well mannered polite girls. But this experience was so poor that I felt a review was necessary.

reviews.author: Lorena Molina Pino
reviews.text: Amazing place! Me and my daughter go from time to time, but the employee we met today (Her name was Nav I’m pretty sure) was so kind! Provided excellent service, and had a wonderful smile. Will be coming back again!

reviews.author: David Torbett
reviews.text:
It was a hot day and this place was great to help cool us off with frozen yogurt!
Lots of choices and topping and good service too!
Even better, it’s gluten free!

reviews.author: Andrea Macias
reviews.text:
For the price we paid, around $220 for one night, I don’t think it was worth it at all.
We were given a room that wasn’t even ready for us. There was still food left behind by the previous guest. Check-in is supposed to be available from 3 PM until 11 PM. I arrived at 5 PM, and when they gave me the room, it wasn’t ready. They then offered us another room, but it was the same situation—it wasn’t ready either. We had to wait about 45 minutes for them to “clean” it.
However, the cleaning was not done properly at all. There was a large hole in the bathroom wall, and the shower floor looked nothing like the pictures shown on the website.
We also used the pool, but it wasn’t clean either. There was a lot of dirt, leaves, and other debris in the water.
We also used the BBQ area, but there was nowhere to dispose of our garbage because all the garbage bins were completely full.
Overall, for the amount we paid, the experience was very disappointing and definitely not worth the price.

reviews.author: Christine Cassalman
reviews.text:
Stayed at this motel over the thanksgiving weekend I reserved and paid for a Deluxe Studio, 2 Queen, Kitchen as per my confirmation. When I arrived and checked in the “front desk” gentleman was rude and ignorant. He provided me with the key and I went into the room and it was the wrong room. I brought it to his attention and he told me I never booked that room and was told he could upgrade for a cost. I showed him the confirmation and the gentleman told me he didn’t care what I was sent this is what I paid for. I had to pay an extra charge to get the room I wanted. When we went into other room the was limited plugs to charge our phones, tablets etc.
we will never stay here again!

reviews.author: Melinda Lukacsi
reviews.text: 5 stars because people are tripping rating this place low. When you look for a place on lundys lane you are not looking for Marriott prices to spend . And for the welcome relaxing environment this is 5 stars in my opinion.  They have upgraded room decor and accommodation to slayers to the most . Where else can you have kids having fun in the pool till close time and the owners let them have another hour to play instead of ruining their fun? The rooms have cutw little upgrades from our last stay and kept clean and serviced for you no matter what your needs are. To our families experience they go above and beyond as staff and owners and thats the heart of Falcon Inn. Personally we won't stay anywhere else when here because theres no reason to look for new when you have a great thing everytime for visit.  Thanks to Rob and the whole of the staff for being so accommodating and letting us enjoy as if it was our own cottage stay. Room 31 is the last room we stayed and I highly recommend you give this place a rating it deserves not a rating you think according to big brand name hotels in comparison.  ✨️✨️✨️✨️✨️ staying 5 stars guest

reviews.author: Dawn
reviews.text: We arrived  air conditioning not working.  Sent someone to fix it took 4 hours.  Room was not very clean.  The door did not lock properly.   My husband was threatened by one of the other guests.  Some shady things going on. In this hotel. Would not recommend the only good was location we left at 9pm that night as we did not feel safe

reviews.author: Jenn Dobson
reviews.text: Room was dirty, hair found in the bed and around the bathroom and jetted tub. Spoke to front desk who “ fixed” the jetted tub only 2 weak jets and it leaks. He was apologetic and offered us a full refund if we left. But also said he would see if he could fix the jets. We stayed. Visable stuff on bathroom floor after cleaning. Bed was not made up on our second day. Garbages were emptied. Tub towels replaced. Didn’t look like anything else was done. Fixtures and furniture very dusty. Tv not great channels were blotchy.

reviews.author: Lynne Gannon
reviews.text: A friend of mine lives there. I went to visit when I was in town. Cockroaches, fruit flies, mice and rats. There are needles everywhere. Police there allllll the time. Packages stolen. I have never seen. anything so disgusting. Nobody cleans up their dog shit. Dogs ein all over. Garbage is always overflowing. The yard is 5 feet deep with weeds. I had 8 ticks on me in 2 hours sitting in front of the building.

reviews.author: Bill Hicks
reviews.text: Will ever see the way back from the end of the week to put it on your phone room is still available but I don't know if I lived there long,but it s me was

reviews.author: DADEFATSAX
reviews.text: Lots of strange/harmless people hanhing around. Not in an uncomfortable way but there non the less. It was what i expected for the price.

reviews.author: Diane Kelsey
reviews.text:
This was by far this worse place. Were to start. Well, first we asked for a smoking room. Didn't get one. But had to sign a waiver if any pot was smoked and detected, it was gonna cost $500.00 regular cigarettes, $200.00. Ok fine. Now we were asked, do you want TV? Well yes, they might be able to get it working. No they didn't. No radio. No phone. No hangers to hang your coats. No heat in the room when we arrived. It was - 15 outside, heat in room would be expected. Had to leave to let the place warm up. Paint peeling so bad in washroom, didn't even want a shower. Oh and when it came time to check out, well now, they didn't open office till 9:00 am, 9:20 still no one there. So there was a phone number to call. It didn't work either. Had to go to another hotel to settle up. They owed us  $100.00 deposit. If you're gonna charge over $200.00 a night, fix up your rooms. Be at the office.
I'll never stay here again. As far as I'm concerned, you owe us a refund for all the inconveniences. And I was told you have 3 other properties. Wow! 😞😞😞😞😞

reviews.author: Dylan Thomas
reviews.text: First room we looked at was filthy, had cigarette burns on the carpet and furnature. The room smelled musty and the door knob was falling apart from the outside. Asked for another room and the staff was friendly. Second room was cleaner but very old. On the bright side the mattresses we're clean and comfortable and water pressure was good. Wouldn't book here again though. I'll post pictures later.

reviews.author: Greg Hamilton
reviews.text:
Surprised by the high reviews.

This place was slow to get the food out, and as you can see from the photo, food was lacking, 2 pancakes, and 1 piece of burned bacon..and this is how it came out of the kitchen.

There were hashbrowns on the floor from a previous table and the older gentleman that was wiping the tables walked all over them and mashed them into the carpet, then proceeded back to his table to play with his phone.

The server was pleasant and she knew they took too long and removed tax off the bill...but don't trust the high rating on Google.

reviews.author: HL Esterly
reviews.text: I was thrilled how seriously they take food allergies. I felt very confident eating their homemade gluten free waffles and I was not disappointed!! Very safe and tasty! I cannot wait to go back to try more!

reviews.author: Trevor Berrea
reviews.text: Excellent food and service at Laurie's Kitchen. Best service the while trip. Great coffee, real orange juice awesome food. Staff was so wonderful with the kids and treated them very well. They don't gauge you on prices either. Will be back every time we visit.

reviews.author: Ben Nero
reviews.text: The other day I had a chance to eat at Joe and Laurie's new location inside the Travelodge Bonaventure Hotel, and the setting is great! Same great food at a very reasonable price, same good service, and the same old Joe, who always treats his customers as friends, and who is always fun to talk to while you wait for your meal. I'm an American who tries to make a point to have a meal at Joe and Laurie's every chance I'm in Canada, and I once again say that if you're looking for a quality breakfast or brunch at reasonable prices, you can't do any better in Niagara Falls than here.

reviews.author: Heather Hamilton
reviews.text: The place appeared grubby with potatoes mashed into the carpet. The service was slow due to someone not showing up for work. A gentleman who was seated got up and started to help with serving. It took an hour for 2 very plain pancakes and a burned twisted piece of bacon....no garnishes at all. The server was pleasant but appeared to be on hyper speed. The condiment containers, salt and pepper shakers and the sugar container needed  cleaning or replacing. Overall, very unsatisfactory.

reviews.author: Robert Van Der Kley
reviews.text:
We ordered ahead for a 5:30 pickup and arrived right on time, but still waited another 10 to 15 minutes for our food.

I ordered the “jumbo shrimp” with fries and was really disappointed. As the photo shows, the shrimp were tiny inside a thick layer of puffed-up, hard batter. The shrimp themselves were extremely overcooked, and I didn’t enjoy the dish at all.

My wife enjoyed her halibut, which is why I’m giving two stars.

reviews.author: Kim Robinson
reviews.text: This is a cute fish n chip place we eyed up the first night and enjoyed it the second night the young guy was super friendly, helpful and great customer service. The food was great..great price ❤️ if we lived here we would definitely come here often.

reviews.author: Marissa Mazzuocco
reviews.text: I ordered their $6 Tuesday special for take out 1 piece fish with chips. I’ll start out by saying the service here is phenomenal, really great person answered the phone with awesome customer service. The food on the other hand…I’m so disappointed by it. The fish was so rubbery and overcooked and the batter was almost stale, though the fish was hot you could’ve convinced me it was 2 days old and refried. I only live 3 minutes away so couldn’t have gotten like that from the restaurant to my house. The fries were OK though majority were butt end of the potato fries and not crispy at all, only soggy which I do t mind soggy fries but most people look for a crunch. The gravy was also just seasoned brown water to my knowledge, it didn’t even stick to the fries. At this point it’s too late to call and complain but maybe they can take some pointers from this review. Won’t be back, even if the service was fabulous.

reviews.author: Donny L
reviews.text: Absolutely unacceptable. I have ordered from Lakeport Fish & Chips on Uber Eats many times and have never been this disappointed. The fish we received was so undercooked that it was unsafe to eat. As you can see from the photo, the fish is extremely pale and still has white, undercooked areas.

reviews.author: A Running
reviews.text: The packaging was beautifully done—it felt like it was lovingly packed by my grandmother. Such a charming, homey touch! The fish and chips were a bit overcooked and dry, but the care in presentation really stood out.

reviews.author: Jennifer Schoenhals
reviews.text: Popped in to buy a quick snack was in for a shock.  We were introduced to something called Ice cream rolls. I had the skor bar with tons of chocolate toppings and my son has the Oreo cookie dough. It was our first time there.  I should have taken a picture of the ice cream but I was too interested in consuming it.  WhWhat a great little gem

reviews.author: Amy Clayton
reviews.text: I absolutely love going to this store they are so nice and he always jokes around and prices arent outrageous here like other corner stores!! They also have the best ice cream ever I 1000% recommend everyone to go for an ice cream here you wont regret it!. Thankyou for being awesome people. 😁

reviews.author: Bear Priest
reviews.text: Stopped in a few items early one morning. The woman working was very helpful and friendly. Prices were good and great customer service.

reviews.author: Eugenie Cabral
reviews.text: Ice cream rolls! The lady was very nice and very talented as well

reviews.author: SAS
reviews.text: The ice cream rolls are amazing

reviews.author: Emily D
reviews.text: Absolutely disgusting and terrible service. I received a medium Canadian pizza that was stale, not even CUT, dried out not melted cheese. I called the restaurant and told to call back because they are busy. This is unsafe to be serving this, I will not be eating here again. It’s a shame that was my dinner for my family. Some reimbursement should be made on behalf of the pizza place. I don’t understand how it is busy if you serve inedible food.

reviews.author: Kelly Dale
reviews.text:
Most disgusting pizza I ever saw in my life. Honestly how could you even send that out!! It wasn’t even cut and when I tried to cut it , hard as Rock !! Old dried out , cheese separating and rubbery! You could tell some pepperoni was thrown on and wasn’t cooked.
This location should be closed and health board should investigate!
Imagine if a child ate this and got sick!!
We called to complain and were told you’re too busy and call later!! Then we returned to store and nothing!! No sorry no manager ( was hiding I’m sure )

reviews.text:
Very disappointing stay — would not recommend, even 1 star is too high of a rating!

Unfortunately, our stay at Niagara Lodge & Suites was extremely disappointing. The cleanliness, comfort, maintenance, and overall condition of the property were far below what we expected.

The bedding was stained, visibly dirty, and had a bad smell, and there was even an oil/grease stain on the comforter. The mattress was horrible and extremely uncomfortable, with the coils pushing against your body. It genuinely felt like sleeping in a hole rather than on a proper mattress. The pillows were also very cheap and uncomfortable.

The suite, bathroom, and floor tiles were dirty, and the entire property felt very old and poorly maintained. The appliances were outdated and barely functioning. The refrigerator was particularly frustrating — you had to fight with the door to get it open, and then struggle again to get it to close properly and stay closed.

Noise was another major issue. The parking lot is located extremely close to the rooms, and there was loud music, talking, and general noise throughout the night. It made it very difficult to sleep and was especially frustrating given how uncomfortable the mattress already was.

The breakfast area was not clean, and the food was bland and disappointing. The only thing that actually tasted good was the coffee.

The one positive aspect of this location is its convenient access to the Falls area, making it easy to get around and close to the attractions.

Overall, the property is in serious need of better cleaning, updated rooms and appliances, proper maintenance, comfortable mattresses and pillows, and better control of nighttime noise. Unfortunately, the convenient location does not make up for the poor condition and uncomfortable experience.

We would not stay here again.

I stayed at this hotel for 2 nights and 3 days, and unfortunately it was one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve had.

The rooms were dirty, extremely cramped, and nothing like the photos advertised on the website. The pictures are very misleading. The bathroom was in terrible condition—the bathtub was dirty, and the toilet wasn’t working properly.

The customer service was equally disappointing. I asked three different housekeeping staff members for fresh towels, and instead of helping, each of them simply pointed at the housekeeping cart and told me to get them myself. I also complained to the front desk, but nothing was done.

The night before checkout, I specifically requested that our room be cleaned while we were out. When we returned, the room had not been cleaned at all. The bedsheets hadn’t been changed, and nothing had been touched. I went back to the front desk that evening, and the staff member told me there was nothing he could do except hand me clean sheets so I could change them myself.

The next morning, when I spoke to the receptionist again, I pointed out that the duvet on the bed had not been changed—it was the exact same duvet from the previous night, with the same cigarette burn marks on it. I explained that I was not comfortable using it because it clearly hadn’t been replaced. Her response was that they “don’t change the duvets,” which is a serious hygiene concern and completely unacceptable for any hotel.

Instead of apologizing or trying to resolve the issue, she also said, “You’ve already stayed for two days, and now you’re complaining. You already used our service.” This was extremely unprofessional, especially since I had already raised the same concerns multiple times during my stay and nothing had been done.

To make matters worse, the beds were so unclean that we woke up feeling itchy after sleeping in them.

Overall, the hotel was dirty, poorly maintained, the staff was unhelpful, and the customer service was unacceptable. I would not recommend staying here, as the hotel does not live up to the standards shown on its website or advertised in its photos.

reviews.author: Kirandeep Kaur
reviews.text: I’ve been meaning to write this review for the longest time, and I’m so glad I finally did! The Purple Mint Kitchen has some of the best Indian food I’ve ever had. As a vegetarian, I especially love the variety of delicious vegetarian options they have. Everything I’ve tried has been so flavorful, fresh, and beautifully prepared. The ambiance is also absolutely beautiful and makes the whole dining experience even better. It’s definitely one of my go-to restaurants, and I’ll keep coming back every time I’m craving amazing Indian food! 💜

reviews.author: Mr Hd
reviews.text:
The food was average at best, and the portion sizes were surprisingly small for the price. What made the experience even more disappointing was the gratuity. For a party of five, gratuity was automatically added to the bill. I had already tipped 15% on a bill of around $100, only to realize afterward that gratuity had already been included. That was quite a surprise and left me feeling like I had paid twice.

Honestly, considering the below-average food quality and small portions, the overall experience was disappointing. Automatically charging gratuity for a party of five, especially when customers may not notice it's already included, feels unfair. I wish this had been communicated more clearly.

Overall, I left feeling overcharged and underwhelmed. Unfortunately, I wouldn't rush back.

reviews.author: Serenity
reviews.text:
This big bee store says they are open 24 Hrs everyday, they are DEFINITELY not open 24 Hrs everyday.

Whenever I come by here to get something like a late night snack, their doors are always locked and this has happened four times! It usually starts around 12:30 AM whenever I came here to come inside and they probably unlock their doors in the early mornings.

I don't know why they can't edit the hours because they can confuse a lot of people doing this!

reviews.author: Jennifer Bishop
reviews.text: The new staff, especially Manny, are friendly, helpful and call you by name. They are helpful and communicate with their customers. It's the store I go to before and after work, in my pj's or dressed to the 9s. Doesn't matter how I enter, I feel welcomed and known and comfortable.  Great set of guys in this place! For a "corner" store, they top my corner store charts lol

reviews.author: Tyler Galway
reviews.text: I went to the store on 13th of August and purchased a carton of 2% milk that was left dated for August 15th and had no other curtains of a later date so then I had opened it on the 14th and it was way past I called the store and he told me there was nothing you could do about it

reviews.author: shiena cruzat
reviews.text: very rude to customer this bald owner!!!! and even the receipt he gave us is just the total ?? omg!! how will i know that you are punching it right!!

reviews.author: manny camilleri
reviews.text: I must say one of the most rudest, arrogant establishments , the worker or owner swears at his customer's and berates people there. The head office should close this place immediately.

reviews.author: Kristian Greene
reviews.text: I went here and got a haircut with Shawn S. He is probably one of the best barbers I’ve been to and got me so right. He’s very talkative and a great guy to talk to with such a bright future. He’s also a newer and upcoming barber there which was shocking to hear as he did such a great job with my haircut and he’s a very affordable barber. Would 10/10 recommend you book with Shawn S at Form barbershop. The shop itself is also very clean and welcoming as well.

reviews.author: Khai N.
reviews.text: I just had a great haircut with Kyle. He was excellent and professional. I'm very happy with his cut. The barbershop is very clean and modern. Will definitely come back. Thanks Kyle.

reviews.author: Bryan Qin
reviews.text: Kyle did a great job with my haircut. He was easy to talk to, took his time, and made sure everything looked clean. Really happy with the result — I’ll definitely be coming back.

reviews.author: Joanne Harris
reviews.text:
We were recommended here by a friend. Unprofessional and rude. My husband walked in and was met with “you can’t just walk in here you have to have an appointment”. Well, thank you. How about next time you say to a potential customer “I apologize I don’t take walk ins sir but I would be happy to book you an appointment”.
Will not book or go back and surely will pass the word along.

reviews.author: Feco Kiss
reviews.text:
Jason is my barber, and he always cuts my hair very well
I’m always satisfied with his work

He is also very kind friendly and polite
He is one of the best

I will definitely come back!

reviews.author: Aubrey Balofiños
reviews.text:
Sports bar with lots of TV, huge food portions and amazing service.
We tried their seafood platter - the haddock taste good. It’s perfect, not heavily breaded; comes with more than 10 shrimp on the platter. It was perfect for me. I can’t even finish the fried.
We also tried their pizza, and wings. Pizza was also good, not soggy, comparable to some good pizza places. Wings are crispy and they’re decently sized.

Overall, no complaints, only good vibes there! I highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Luis Arias
reviews.text: We visited Chip’s Charlie’s and had a Canadian burger, and it was absolutely delicious. The burger was juicy, well prepared, and full of flavor, and the fries were crispy and perfectly cooked. Everything was served fresh and tasted great. The server was very attentive and professional, which made the experience even better. A very satisfying meal and a place I’d definitely come back to.

reviews.author: Lynn V
reviews.text: Went to Chip N Charlie’s Eatery & Bar for dinner and drinks.  We had to pay cover at the front to get in.  Never had to do that before.  Well worth it!  The band The Orangeman were simply amazing!! Played great dancing songs and got the crowd going!  The food and drinks were as per usual… fantastic!

reviews.author: Farzin Zaker
reviews.text: Our table’s meals were not served at the same time, which was disappointing. However, the manager personally stopped by our table, listened to our concerns, and took immediate action to make things right. Their professionalism and genuine care completely turned the situation around. What started as a frustrating experience became a truly memorable one. Excellent customer service can make all the difference, and the manager certainly proved that.

reviews.author: HOOTS C
reviews.text:
stopped in with my woman for some fish n 🍟,  really good. I recommend the 2 piece even if you can't finish it (i couldn't) reheat in the airfryer np. fresh slaw and chips and many drinks to choose from.

Gonna come back and see about this breakfast  special lol on Sunday
