reviews.author: Harold Styles
reviews.text: I paid $296 for this motel. It’s not clean and the staff woman was rude. The bathroom was rusted and bedsheets were not clean. And towels were also not clean, you can see the stains.   You should pay only around $60 for this motel. It’s not worth it.  One guest should be allowed, but they charged me $100 more because I invited a guest. You should stay in other motels.

reviews.author: Jay Pay
reviews.text:
Not a bad price... not a great price.

Room was a mess, moving the TV uncovered a whole disgusting Walk of Life. There was no J trap in the sink, a mere plastic tube waiting to spew toxins into the air... also got a one-bed when we ask for two.

Won't be back.

reviews.author: Dave Dowling
reviews.text:
Lots of mold in the tub. Tub it's self was very stained and dirty looking.
Stayed three nights and the never gave new towels or made up the room.
I only paid $60.cad a night, so didn't expect too much.

reviews.author: kim mcgrath
reviews.text: Rooms ate clean and big , cable, no phone but comfy beds no bugs, very quiet and friendly staff , would recommend to friends and family and great price doesn't look like much from outside but has a home away from home feel very spacious good nights sleep will be back when visiting the area..

reviews.author: Alex Artamonov
reviews.text: Better than the lowest cost options in this area. I paid with cash without issues. Staff are caring. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: jordan Pegg
reviews.text: DO NOT BOOK! I found this place on Airbnb and it was truly misleading… the photos looked clean and spacious but as soon as we walked in the room smelt like cigarettes and we noticed that there was no deadbolt on the door. The place was unbelievably dirty and eerie so much so that we had to book another hotel and only stayed at the inn for an hour. The tv didn’t even work!  All of these five star reviews are clearly fake!!

reviews.author: Vanessza Orgona
reviews.text: Love this place my boyfriend and I spent a week here service was amazing and their shawarma is excellent!! Definitely recommend!!!

reviews.author: Molly
reviews.text: This motel is one of the best motels I have ever stayed at. Everyone there is beyond nice and kind. It is very very clean and th prices are amazing I recommend this place

reviews.author: Emily
reviews.text: this motel is truly one of a kind. Everything is amazing the people and the rooms! I recommend this motel to ANYONE coming to Niagara. It is so clean and spotless I recommend!

reviews.author: Susu
reviews.text: I went here for a stay. And I have to say this place was amazing everyone was super nice and everything was so clean.if you are looking for a stay I recommend this place.

reviews.author: Edward Kurms (Fast Eddy)
reviews.text: It's now under new management and it's called the Rockwell Resort.  The owner was very friendly and even served us breakfast every morning.  Owner really cares about this place. Lots of families were here.  Pool is clean and full of kids.  A few noisy people on Friday night but not so bad.  Rooms are clean.  Hey, for this price, you can't go wrong.  Overall satisfied with our two night stay.  Would come again.

reviews.author: nik_k
reviews.text: Excellent value for the money. Location is good, ample parking. Rooms are clean with high speed internet and fridge and microwave. Clean bedding and towels. Basic breakfast is included. There was also a small pool which i didn't use. Rating it with 4 stars because the building was a little old and the air conditioner was old and noisy. But still-a good deal

reviews.author: Jason Zaborsky
reviews.text: Great staff!  I arrived after cosing but the poor guy was tired, but happy to help and friendly.  To make matters worse, I locked myself out around 4am and had to get another key.  Still happy to help.  I will be returning to this great value hotel. Bathtub was huge and room was spacious.  Very satisfied!!!! ALSO....extended my stay because it was so good!

reviews.author: Missy T.D
reviews.text: Good location. It was close to the Falls and Clifton Hill. Check in was easy, ample parking. The outdoor pool and gazibo was nice. Downside: The hot water didn't work in the jacuzzi tub. The fridge didn't run cold, neither did the air conditioner. We killed about 12 earwigs in our room. The cost per night, for what we got, was too expensive. They charged almost $450 for two nights.

reviews.author: Anton Walker
reviews.text:
A nice little inn that is 10 minutes drive from the comic con.

Place is clean and staff are very nice and polite.

We left our stuff in the room while out for the day and when the garbage a were done and towels replaced, nothing else was touched or went missing.

Price was very good and inexpensive (we booked through expedia) and the look and feel of the place reminds me of a hotel you would find in Florida.

The place is kept clean and the pool is well maintained.

The only downside is that it's not a quite hotel. Loud trucks or a very loud motorcycle going down the street will be heard like its outside the room. We were on the second floor and there was a party going on in the room below us and it could be heard like it was outside the door.

I would stay here again, but not during partying season.

reviews.author: Olha Lepska
reviews.text: Don't let the location fool you—inside, a truly cozy atmosphere awaits! It’s a wonderfully warm and inviting space where you’ll want to linger a bit longer. The service was top-notch: friendly, prompt, and attentive without being intrusive. A fantastic spot I’ll definitely be returning to!

reviews.author: James Pellegrino
reviews.text:
I’ve visited several times now, and unfortunately I still haven’t had a good meal here.

The cod portion is very small — you really need to order the two-piece. It also comes breaded, which isn’t indicated on the menu and was unexpected. The risotto it's served on is mushy and had the consistency of baby food.

The bacon cheeseburger was one of the worst burgers I’ve had. It was overcooked and piled so high with bacon that grease was dripping off the bun. I sent it back because it was just so gross.

The chicken burger was equally disappointing — messy and bone dry.

The espresso was burnt and even had coffee grounds in the cup. At this point, investing in a commercial Nespresso machine would likely provide more consistency.

For the price, you would expect much more for what you pay.

On a positive note, the servers have been kind and understanding each time. I can only imagine they spend a lot of time sending plates back to the kitchen.

reviews.author: Gina C
reviews.text: Very modern, nice place. We went for an earlier dinner. Started off awkward, our first server all you can smell was alcohol on her breath and she wasn't very friendly. But then Felicia took over, and she was amazing! Friendly, warm, and nice. The food was fresh and delicious! Average prices $13 for cocktails. $25 main $15 appetizer.

reviews.author: Adam Smith
reviews.text:
We visited for Mother’s Day and the food was excellent. The sauce and veal were especially outstanding and reminded me of a comforting homemade meal. The quality and flavor of the food really stood out.

The main challenge was the service, which felt quite slow during the busy holiday rush. The restaurant was also very loud, making conversation difficult at times. On a positive note, the hostess was incredibly hardworking and impressive, constantly helping by cleaning tables, resetting areas, and assisting guests while keeping things moving.

Overall, the food was excellent and there were some standout staff members, though service and crowd management could be improved during peak times.

reviews.author: GirlOnTheGoGo
reviews.text: Great food, and classy atmosphere. Their patio is small and nice for sitting out on a warmer day. Always look forward to dessert for a piece of cheesecake. Their selection is usually pretty extensive, and portion is large enough to share. Always look forward to going back with family and friends!

reviews.author: William “WR_OReilly” O'Reilly
reviews.text: The budtenders are knowledgeable and helpful. Great prices and membership is free! They have good inventory & supply. If you want something specific ask for it, every day they have specific specials in my included picture!

reviews.author: Richard
reviews.text: I went to this establishment to get a dab cartridge. I went in and said that I would like a “cart”, and the blonde girl working said “a cartridge?” And I said yes like a vape cartridge. So this is understood that I was asking for a cartridge, not a pack of joints. This girl hands me a little bottle thing which carts usually come in (depends on the brand) and I went to the car to check if it was leaking or anything, and it was joints! Not a cart! I was not mad or aggravated as this was a misunderstanding that could be fixed. I called the store and calmly expressed that I wanted a cartridge instead of joints. She got so heated on the phone and started accusing me and saying that it was my fault and I was the one that asked for joints and was just really hostile to me. This experience made me not want to come back again, which sucks because I live very close and I was a regular there! It also sucks because the guy who works there is really nice and has great customer service! Once with him, I had a cart that was fully leaking and walked back in and he happily took care of it with great customer service! This happened around a year ago but I thought of it and got bothered because I’ve never been treated like that for no reason, and I’ve never left a review before in my life because I usually don’t care but.. wow! I don’t go to this place just in case this girl is working because she always has some sort of unsettling attitude.

reviews.author: Abigail Purcer
reviews.text:
I’m genuinely sorry, but this was one of the worst dispensary experiences I’ve had. I’d rather smoke a wet sock soaked in bong water than come back here.

My friend went in to buy a cart, and the cashier processed the purchase before even showing him the brand. Turns out he was given Back Forty, which anyone who knows, knows it’s pretty bottom-tier. At the very least, you could’ve offered something better like an XPLORER cart like seriously?
When he realized and politely asked to switch it right away, he was told there were no exchanges or refunds since “nothing was wrong” with the cart.

That’s not the point. Customers should be told exactly what they’re buying before the transaction is completed especially with cannabis. He tried to fix it immediately and was still refused, so now he’s stuck with a cart he didn’t even want.

And to make it worse, the product itself is terrible. We’ve been hitting it for hours and feel absolutely nothing.

Overall, bad service, poor communication, and a disappointing product. Would not recommend. Stay loyal and true to Honeypot because they have an amazing customer service and never let me down

reviews.author: Sarah S
reviews.text: This place is great. Super convenient. The guy that's always working is friendly and helpful with suggestions. My go to for pre-rolls.

reviews.author: Margaret Morin
reviews.text: Great friendly staff and they always have my products in stock also love the late hours of being open.

reviews.author: Lamech
reviews.text:
Very disappointing, not worth the price. Overall, this was a very disappointing experience, and I'm honestly not sure if I would ever be back.

To be fair, there were some positives. The store layout was clean and tidy, and the attendant was friendly and pleasant. The space itself felt welcoming, and the server was kind.

Unfortunately, the food just wasn't worth what I paid for it. The banh mi sandwich was dry, and the bread was hard — not fresh or soft the way you'd expect it to be. It was hard to enjoy, and it really stood out as a letdown.

I also ordered the chicken and beef with rice. The plate was extremely full with rice, but the beef portion was very little, and the chicken portion was also small. It felt unbalanced — mostly rice, with hardly any of the meat that was supposed to be the main part of the dish.

For the price, it wasn't worth it at all. I left feeling disappointed, especially because the place itself is clean and the staff are friendly. If the portions and the quality of the food matched the price, this could have been a much better visit — but as it was, I can't recommend it based on value.

reviews.author: Bob Saget
reviews.text:
I ordered for take out and I really did not love that they do not separate the raw meat from the noodles. They were aware that I was ordering one soup for multiple people as they kept calling me about my order. They still chose to keep all of the cooked and raw meat in one bowl where other places usually separate in plastic for safety.

It was decent tasting but not great. The price is a bit too high in my opinion considering quality.

reviews.author: Nick Mitchell
reviews.text: Not enough good things to say about this place! Absolutely fantastic food! Such a great family run business.. The owners Brian and his wife HƯƠNG along with their daughter NGỌC are such wonderful people who go above and beyond to make sure their customers are satisfied! The food here is authentic and full of amazing flavours and is always made fresh! I highly recommend checking them out next time you're in Niagara Falls and want some delicious true authentic Vietnamese food!!

reviews.author: MELANIE WILLIAMSON
reviews.text: We ordered 2 pad Thai, noodles with what was supposed to be chicken, shrimp and pork with veggies but came with additional stuff in it, and a fried rice. The rice was good,  the pad Thai is over cooked and flavorless, the noodles came seperate from the sauce, the noodles are over cooked in all 3 dishes and came stuck together like glue, the sauce that came to be added on the noodles is watered down and like soup and the flavor is awful! $70 bucks wasted! My daughter and son in law said it used to be a good place  🤷‍♀️...maybe they are if you eat in house but I would never recommend it for take out! Or maybe this industry and style of food is new to the new owner/management?! Either way, we will not be back

reviews.author: James Kehoe
reviews.text: I ordered a vegetarian Pho because my wife is allergic and she got a seafood Pho...Thankfully I opened hers 1st and noticed or she would be fighting for her life. Absolutely unacceptable

reviews.author: Helen KL
reviews.text: We stayed here as a family of 4 and as a value option in Niagra I really couldn’t fault it. The beds were comfy, the shower over the bath was powerful and even when all 4 of us had back to back showers the hot water never cooled. Air con was included and you had a sink in bathroom as well as a big sink area in the room. Fridge freezer was great for freezing our drinks before heading out each day. We really liked the location, about a 2 min walk from hotel is a bus stop which takes you to Niagra falls and it takes about 10 mins to get there on the bus. An Uber is also an option and is about 14 dollars. Lundy lane has plenty of choice for eateries; breakfast, lunch and dinner… local options and fast food ones. On our second day we went to the water park at Americana which is about a 5 min walk from the hotel. We had breakfast at scoops opposite, amazing service and food, Tim Hortons was our other breakfast choice and we had dinner all 3 nights at Chip and Charlie’s (think pub style) all of these were a matter of minutes walk from hotel. My boys LOVED the hotel pool which is crystal clear and has a diving board and next to it is a small play equipment slides, swings etc. overall I would really recommend and would stay again.

reviews.author: Brett D
reviews.text: Just as advertised. Great giant Heart shaped tub in perfect working order.   Way better value staying here as opposed to a Days inn or Equivalent. About half the price.   Sure it’s a motel you drive up to your room. Convenient though.   There may have been. Shadyish kinda people staying in other rooms maybe long term. But no issues , always felt safe and this place provided just what we needed for a fun romantic weekend away.   Easy $14 uber to the falls area.  Would stay again just for the fun Kitchy room.

reviews.author: C M
reviews.text: I thought I had booked a decent place to stay but to my surprise it was very uncomfortable. The bed was the worst I have ever slept in, really hoping I did not bring home any bed bugs.  The hot tub was so loud, jets were minimal and the glasses they left were both broken. The toilet was so low I felt like I had to be a toddler to sit on it.  The ice machine was still locked at 11:00 a.m. the next morning when I wanted to refill my water.  And last but not least the internet kept cutting out and it was such a process just to log on to their tv. I was not impressed at all and would never ever stay at this place again.

reviews.author: Carrie
reviews.text: I was happy with the room and service. Unfortunately I left an expensive travel sweatshirt in the room when I left and didn’t realize, when I called a few days later I was told there was nothing in the room. Myself and my daughter remember it hanging on the chair in the room before we checked out, my fault for leaving it just wish it was found so I could return and pick it up.

reviews.author: Bigtom
reviews.text:
Got ripped off by the owner/manager/front desk staff. Upon checking out he went to check our room so we could get our deposit back ... When he returns he tries to tell us we broke a drawer and he was keeping our deposit. We had one backpack with us and never even used a drawer. The place was filthy disgusting with marks all over the walls stains on floor. Dust everywhere and dirt on floors.  He over charged us right off the hoop telling me that the booking.com price was for one person lol  that makes no sense.
All in all I would avoid staying here cause he will set you up in room 224 and try to rip you off too .. it's a scam .. they know that the drawer is broken already and will try to blame you for it too.

reviews.author: study hard
reviews.text:
I absolutely love Shawarma & Grillbox! It’s a really great restaurant with delicious food, good prices, and such a friendly atmosphere. The food is always fresh, flavorful, and made with care. The shawarma is especially delicious, and there are plenty of options to choose from, whether you’re looking for a quick meal or something more filling.

One of the best things about this restaurant is the prices. The portions are good, and you get great value for your money. It’s nice to find a restaurant where the food is good quality without being overpriced.

The people who work here are also very kind, welcoming, and respectful. The service is friendly, and they always make you feel comfortable and appreciated as a customer. You can really tell that they care about their customers and take pride in what they do.

Overall, Shawarma & Grillbox is definitely one of those restaurants I would recommend to anyone. Great food, great prices, friendly people, and a welcoming atmosphere. Whether you’re a regular customer or visiting for the first time, I’m sure you’ll have a great experience. I will definitely be coming back again and would happily recommend this place to my family, friends, and anyone looking for a delicious and affordable meal! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Greg Sy
reviews.text:
Had so much shawarma in my life but this place is one of a kind!! Wael is no joke and the food he served us is nothing short of amazing!

If you want quality food then you found it!! Don't just take my review for it but go check it out yourself!! We took one bite and it was spectacular!! The flavors are vibrant and the portion is worth it!! I would've paid more!!

Please do yourself a favor and go visit this place to experience great food for yourself!

The chicken platter was fresh and tasty!

reviews.author: Karim Sayani
reviews.text:
This place used to be one of our absolute go-to spots. The flavors, quality of the rice, chicken, and kebabs were always on point, and honestly, their shawarma was easily in my top 5.

Unfortunately, after coming back for the first time in 4–5 months, the experience was really disappointing.

The rice and chicken shawarma were drenched in oil, and the kebabs were excessively salty and nothing like they used to be. They previously had a soft texture with a great smoky flavor — this time they were dry, overcooked, and overwhelmingly salty.

To make matters worse, everything was covered in a red sauce that tasted like fermented Frank’s RedHot sauce, and they even added an extra sachet of it in the takeout container.

Really hoping this was just an off day because the quality drop was very noticeable compared to what this place used to be.

reviews.author: Ryan Fitzgerald
reviews.text: We were craving some shawarma while in Niagara Falls and by chance drove by this little building. We were sceptical at first, but once we started talking to the owner that quickly changed. The service was amazing, the owner had such a positive attitude, that alone was worth the visit. I tried the chicken Shawarma on rice, very reasonable serving. The chicken was well seasoned as was the rice. The garlic sauce was also on point. It definitely hit the spot. We will be returning in the near future. If you are in the area and have a hankering for some chicken Shawarma, definitely recommend you try Shawarma & Grill Box.

reviews.author: mini
reviews.text: Such a great place! The food is delicious, fresh, and packed with flavour. The shawarma and grill box were both amazing, and the portions were generous. The prices are also really good for the amount and quality of food you get. The staff were super friendly and welcoming too. Definitely a place I would recommend to anyone looking for good food at a great price!

reviews.author: Bob Anderson
reviews.text:
I’ve driven by this treasure more times than I can count.
3 people independently told me you need to go here.
Today I did and it won’t be the last time I stop in here.
Yes it’s a deli featuring a delicious array of various spreads like mustards, and different types of sauerkraut.
The sandwiches are out of this world.

Picture yourself eating the freshest of bread laden with meat and cheese. You will have to, because I devoured mine before I could take a picture.

The prices vary but my ham and mozzarella foot long was $7.22 after tax.

I felt like I was stealing from them it was such a great deal.

The staff were friendly and helpful.

100% I will be back for more!!!

reviews.author: Justin Otten
reviews.text: Lovely little deli and exceptional burek--some of the best I've ever had, and I lived in Macedonia for a long time--which was also very reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Tom McManaman
reviews.text: Great prices. Lots of eastern European options. Cheap and delicious deli subs. Friendly staff!

reviews.author: Dom P. (perhotti92)
reviews.text: Come here if you want a slice of Balkan heaven! Make sure to check out the cured meats section!!

reviews.author: Nevena Cukućan
reviews.text:
If there's one business that truly understands what customer service means, it's Balkan Deli — and Suzana is the living proof of that.

Every single visit, she goes above and beyond. Out of stock on something you need? No problem — Suzana will either suggest the perfect substitute on the spot or, better yet, take your phone number and call you personally the moment the item is back in stock. How many businesses you shop at do that these days?

Suzana's approach to customer success is something every business should study and replicate. She is the kind of person who turns a one-time visitor into a loyal customer for life.

Highly, highly recommended 🙌

Also, if you'd like to try something new - try their kiflice 🥐 (the cheese or jam pastry) on Friday and Saturday mornings. Be quick, they sell out fast!

reviews.author: Deevo

reviews.text: Nicky and staff are very attentive to their customers providing excellent service. The salon is always spotless and welcoming. The package price is unbeatable. There is never a wait, fast and convenient!

reviews.author: Mads
reviews.text: Cool beds, clean salon, good lotion selection. The Velocity high pressure bed was comfortable for me as someone with bad hips, the curve of the acrylic was much easier on my back than your standard flat acrylic surface. Only thing is some of the buttons/functions don't work anymore, but still felt nice and hot.

reviews.text: Emailed them with some questions but I guess no one must work there; no response whatsoever. Not very customer orientated it seems.

reviews.author: Karla
reviews.text: Nurse Nicolette is great :) I immediately felt comfortable as she was very personable and easy to communicate with. LOVING my results and will definitely be seeing her again. 10/10 recommend!

reviews.author: Constantine Korjov
reviews.text: Been coming here for a while. Great beds, excellent quality. The staff is very friendly and service is fast. Highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Charlett Thompson Morgan
reviews.text:
Visited this health store today. The owners are knowledgeable about their products and can offer suggestions based on individual needs.
The customer service is excellent 👌🏼
I will be returning to this location for future health needs.

reviews.author: Labelle Michelle
reviews.text:
I stumbled upon this store with the purpose of finding vitamins and I’m glad that I did.
The lady working at the store who is also the owner was extremely knowledgeable and patient. She listened to my concerns and recommended the appropriate vitamins for myself and my family. I will definitely be back . This business is a much needed staple to the Niagara community.

reviews.author: Shelby the Small
reviews.text: During my trip to Canada I stopped in and found some lotion that’s great for my skin. If you’re looking for specific products that are relatively hard to find this place was great

reviews.author: Jack Donaghy
reviews.text: Although the prices can be higher-than-average on some products, everything here is high-quality. They carry brands you don't find in your average health store or at the supermarket. The staff are very knowledgeable, always willing to help, and it's a great place to pick up health and wellness essentials. This may very well be the best health and wellness store in Niagara Falls.

reviews.author: Lisa Gregoire
reviews.text: My sister and I visited last Sunday as they advertised lots of Keto products.  Jordan was amazing and took so much time with us to explain different supplements and to recommend certain products.  I have to tell you that when we left the store, we were in such a good mood from our interaction with him and his extensive knowledge and warm demeanor.  Amongst other recommendations, I have been blown away by the effectiveness of Natural Factors Double Strength Theracurmin. He stated that one capsule was as effective as a Tylenol 3 and he was right!  I have taken 2 of them so far on different days for ongoing headaches and should pain.  I took one approximately 20 minutes ago and feel so much better!  The costs are higher than online but when you’re getting one on one advice and education, that’s something you can’t find on Amazon!  Jordan you’re awesome!

reviews.author: Anees Thapa
reviews.text: I had a great experience. I got my eyebrows threaded and my hair cut, and I’m really happy with the results. The service was excellent, and the staff were friendly and professional. They did a great job, and I would definitely recommend this place to others. I’ll be coming back again.😊❤️

reviews.author: Harpreet Kaur
reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience at Beauty by Meenu. From the moment I entered, I was impressed by the warm, welcoming atmosphere, cleanliness, and professionalism of the entire team.
A special thank you to Meenu for my nails, hair colour, root touch-up, and highlights. Kulvinder (KD) did an exceptional job with my facial, makeup, and hairstyle, and Himangi did a beautiful job with my eyelash lift and tint.
I also received threading and waxing services, and I was extremely pleased with the quality and attention to detail throughout every service. The entire team was courteous, professional, and genuinely committed to making my experience comfortable and enjoyable.
I truly appreciate the care and expertise everyone provided. An excellent salon with talented professionals and outstanding customer.

reviews.author: Divyanshi
reviews.text: I’ve been a regular customer here and I always have a great experience. My eyebrows and nails are always done perfectly. I’ve also had facials and waxing done here and the service is excellent every time. very clean place. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: amandeep singh
reviews.text:
We ordered several pizzas from City South Pizza for our cricket team, and we were very impressed! The pizzas were fresh, delicious, loaded with toppings, and full of flavour. Everything was prepared perfectly and the quality was excellent.
The service was also outstanding—friendly, professional, and our order was ready as promised. Great food, great service, and a perfect choice for feeding the whole team!
Highly recommend City South Pizza! 5 stars all the way!

reviews.author: Doug Davis
reviews.text: A fantastic pizza place with some unique flavors.  So many options on the menu.  We had the tandoori chicken and it was delicious.  The cheese blend was perfect. Cheesy goodness. The samosas were golden brown and awesome. The staff was friendly, informative about the unique toppings, drinks and more on the menu. For sure coming here for pizza next time!

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.text:
Today, I ordered a veggie pizza and clearly explained what kind of pizza I wanted, but unfortunately, I did not receive the pizza I ordered.
When I called back, I explained that we did not like the pizza we received because it was not what we had expected. The guy on the phone admitted that he was new and that he was the person who took the order. However, they still refused to provide a new pizza according to the order we originally placed.

This is the first time we have experienced something like this in the last five years, and I am very disappointed. I will never come back again.

Even the toppings were extremely limited, which was unbelievable and completely unexpected from the City South Pizza franchise. I expected much better service and quality.

reviews.author: Diljit
reviews.text:
We ordered pizzas for a big party, and the experience was excellent from start to finish. The highlight was definitely the Tandoori Paneer Pizza — it was absolutely delicious. The paneer was soft, fresh, and perfectly marinated with rich tandoori flavors. The balance of spices was just right, not overpowering, and it paired beautifully with the cheese and sauce.
The crust was well-baked, crispy on the outside and soft inside, and the toppings were generous on every slice. All the pizzas arrived hot and fresh, which is impressive considering the large order. Everyone at the party loved the food, and the Tandoori Paneer pizza was the most talked-about item.
This place is a great choice for big gatherings, parties, or events where you want quality and taste without compromise. Highly recommended — will definitely order again! 🍕🔥

reviews.author: Narinder
reviews.text: I heard about this place, so I decided to give it a try. I ended up ordering the tandoori paneer and samosa poutine and they were amazing. Everything came out hot and fresh, and the staff were really welcoming especially Naaz who helped me with my order and made the whole visit feel even more special. Definitely a hidden gem worth stopping for, even if you’re from out of town.😊😊

I recently visited  medplus and was helped pharmacist whose name I believe starts with “I” (possibly Izrial). She was absolutely wonderful — very soft-spoken, patient, and took the time to explain in detail how to take my medication. She went above and beyond to make sure I understood everything and felt comfortable before leaving. There is also an Indian pharmacist who is always very helpful and kind. Both of them truly care about their customers and provide excellent service — I really appreciate their professionalism and support!

reviews.author: Elder Cordeiro
reviews.text:
I wanted some gnocchi with sausage in a container. She said it was $18 plus tax, so I asked her for the individual prices. She said the sausage was $10. Who pays $10 for a sausage? Better yet, who charges $10 for a sausage?
So then I asked for a veal sandwich. She literally puts two little strips of cheese on it. Why can’t you guys give a slice of provolone? People see these things. You’re trying to say five bucks at the end of the year?

She literally made my sandwich with cheese on one side, the middle empty, and cheese on the other side. I don’t get it. Then I asked for some rapini on the sandwich, and she said it was $1.50.

I left. I will never come here again. As soon as you walk in, you get the sensation of being overpriced.

And by the way, the buns were cold, not room temperature—cold, like a fridge.

reviews.author: ryan
reviews.text: The eggplant on a bun is amazing. Fills me up without bloating. The bread is amazing too. My daughter ate half of it with butter and said how delicious it is. Pastries look EPIC.  Pies and donuts and strudels and Nanaimo bars.

reviews.author: Glen McGuire
reviews.text: Visited twice this week while in the area, both times we had lunch from the hot table, and bought baked goods.  All excellent. Staff was friendly and helpful.  Some other reviews commented otherwise on the staff, our experience was great.  Will return next time we're in town!

reviews.author: Leila Smith
reviews.text: The bread quality has really gone downhill. We've been shopping at La Farina since they opened in their former location so it's been a very long time. We usually buy cold cuts, cheeses, pizza dough and bread. This review is really about the bread. Every loaf we've bought lately tastes stale and/or full of air pockets which means overproofing, under kneading or too much flour. Whatever it is we're tired of paying for bread with huge holes in the centre and will go elsewhere. The picture is the sourdough we bought this week which actually has smaller holes. Last week the whole wheat loaf we had were double to 3 times this size.

reviews.author: adam
reviews.text:
just wow, 16.75$ i paid for 5 items. 2 canolis, 1 cinnamon roll, 1 cheesecake and 1 danish.

First of all i walked in and I look at the baked goods and its all empty, 1.5 hours before close mind you. I say is this it and the lady  goes yeah thats it. reviews.author: J Ghuman
reviews.text: Vince deserves a huge shoutout for his amazing service and creativity! 🎃☕ I asked if my drink could be served in a real pumpkin as a fun fall activity, and he made it happen! He went above and beyond to help make my little fall idea come to life, and the drink was absolutely delicious, too. It’s employees like Vince who make the Starbucks experience extra special. Thank you, Vince, for making my fall day so much more fun and memorable! 🍂🧡

reviews.author: Day Trippin
reviews.text:
What happened to Starbucks being ‘the third place’!? As much as I like the choice of music in here, it’s playing much too loud.

I am neurodivergent, and what might seem like ‘normal volume’ for normal folks is loud and distracting for us. Even when I wear a pair of noise-cancelling headphones, the music still rises well above an acceptable noise level.

I find it difficult to work comfortably here. While this may not apply to everyone, neurodivergent awareness is trending, and lowering the music volume would help a great deal. We are more sensitive to sound than the average person, and limiting that input helps us focus.

I do appreciate how kind the baristas have been — very pleasant and accommodating interactions — so it would seem the staff is open to feedback. Could you please cut the music volume in half, if not a quarter? Thank you!

reviews.text:
I ordered a london fog with oat milk and it was the most disgusting thing I have ever had. No earl grey taste whatsoever. It tasted like a combination of oat milk and water, but it was somehow bitter? There were two tea bags inside of the cup so I am not sure how this was even possible.

Now, I haven’t been to a starbucks location for a while - so I can’t say for sure whether this issue is specific to this starbucks in particular.

reviews.author: Rosemary D
reviews.text: I was in shock today when I went to Starbucks to get a Puppuccino for my 8 lb. Maltese dog.  It was his birthday!  These whipped cream cups have been free for many years and today when I went to get one they told me they were no longer free and that I would have to purchase something.  I only get these once a year for my dog.  Starbucks charges enough for the things they sell and I'm sure they could still afford to give puppies a cup once a year.  The other issue I have is when there are not enough workers in the shop to take your orders quickly.  Today there were only 2 workers with cars lined up outside and a lineup inside.  Those poor girls were rushing as fast as they could to satisfy the customers.  I blame this on the company that they do not have enough workers.  And the rich get richer!
